subject.title: [Bug]: Codex conversation bindings lose first-turn routing and resume history

question: Should the Codex runtime owner sponsor a bounded fix that makes the prepared bound session authoritative across first-turn dispatch, command lookup, persistence, and restart resume?
rationale: The issue is protected for maintainer handling and affects compatibility-sensitive provider/session routing; the exact Codex app-server contract must be checked directly before selecting the permanent repair boundary.

options.title: Sponsor a bounded session-identity repair
options.body: Trace the prepared binding through all four reported paths and add regressions that prove canonical targeting and same-thread recovery after restart.

options.title: Narrow the report after owner investigation
options.body: If one alleged path already uses the authoritative bound session, split only the remaining reproducible path into a focused issue or fix.

recommendation.title: Sponsor a bounded session-identity repair
recommendation.body: Trace the prepared binding through all four reported paths and add regressions that prove canonical targeting and same-thread recovery after restart.

likelyOwner.reason: Prior Codex app-server lifecycle history makes this the strongest available routing candidate for the affected session-resume boundary.
